canvas.note: Design resolution (portrait). Use a Godot Control root sized 1152x2048 with stretch mode 'canvas_items' / aspect 'keep' so it scales to any Android device.

palette.note: 1-bit look: only two tones used almost everywhere (dark navy-black #1a1d24 and white #ffffff). Sprites/icons are white-line art on transparent bg; on the light arena floor they get filter invert(1) (in Godot: use a shader or a pre-inverted texture variant) so the linework reads dark-on-light.

font.note: Pixel font. Import the .ttf into Godot (download from Google Fonts) and set as DynamicFont/Theme default. Sizes used: 17-20px at this canvas scale.

layers_bottom_to_top: map_fullscreen.png (0,0 1152x2048) - full background art: walls + arena floor baked in one image
arena_units_layer (43,126 1065x1023, clipped/overflow hidden) - enemy + ally sprites and their HUD (level, heart/hp or element badge, hp bar)
layout_dark_overlay.png (0,0 1152x2048) - dark navy vignette/border overlay on top of units, under frame art
frame art (screen_outer_frame, arena_frame, bag_frame, next_frame, fusion_lane_frame, affinity frames)
top HUD (floor, score, round pips, gems, coins, menu button)
bottom HUD (player heart, hp bar, energy, hp/energy numbers)

container.note: All enemy/ally coordinates below are ALREADY given relative to this container's local origin (i.e. subtract 43/126 from the raw screen coords you see in map art).

arena.enemy_hud_rule: Each enemy shows: Lv label above sprite, a heart-outline icon + numeric HP to its side, NO skill/hp bar.
arena.ally_hud_rule: Each ally shows: Lv label above sprite, an ELEMENT badge (framed icon matching its element, inverted so it reads dark-on-white) in the bottom-right corner of its sprite, and a horizontal skill/hp bar below the sprite. Allies do NOT show a heart or numeric HP.

hud_offsets_from_unit_box.level_label: centered above sprite top edge, ~7px gap
hud_offsets_from_unit_box.heart_or_element_badge: 44x46 frame / 38x36 icon, anchored to bottom-right corner of the sprite box (element badge) OR small 24x22 icon near hp text (enemy heart)
hud_offsets_from_unit_box.hp_or_skill_bar: below sprite, ~125px reference width scaled per unit (barRefW), 21px tall

round_pips.note: filled circle = completed round, outlined circle = current/future round

player_hp_bar.note: fill width = (hp/maxHp) * 441 px, clipped inside track art

bag.gameplay: FIFO queue of card types. Drawing a card from the bag shifts the queue and appends a new random type at the end. 'NEXT' slot always previews queue[0].

field.gameplay: 10 playable card slots drawn from the bag at battle start. Tapping a filled card (only when a fusion-lane slot is empty and energy > 0) moves it into the fusion lane and spends 1 energy; the emptied field slot redraws a new card from the bag after a short delay.

fusion_lane.gameplay: 3 slots. When all 3 are filled: if all 3 cards share the same type -> SUCCESS (fusePulse invert-flash animation), deals damage to a random alive enemy, +25 score, +25 gems, +1 energy (capped), screen flash. If types differ -> FAIL (shakeX animation), no reward. Either way lane clears back to empty after the animation.

affinity_chain.note: Static reference chart showing which element beats which (dragon>knight>nature>fire loop; light<->dark opposition). Icons ~50-56px, arrows 36x48.

card_wiggle.keyframes: 0%/100% no transform, 25% translate(-1,1) rotate(-1.5deg), 50% translate(0,-1) rotate(0), 75% translate(1,1) rotate(1.5deg)
card_wiggle.note: Idle shake on every bag + field card icon, staggered per-slot delay so they never sync.

card_in.trigger: a new card appears in a field/lane slot

hit_flash.effect: sprite + hp bar fill invert flash

gameplay_state.loop_summary: Player taps field cards to fill the 3-slot fusion lane, spending energy. Matching-type triples fuse into an attack on a random enemy and refund energy + reward currency. Non-matching triples fail with no penalty besides the spent energy/cards. Repeat until enemies are defeated or player hp reaches 0.
